title: BodyColorAttributeResistance
description: Per-color attribute resistance rules, keyed by color id. Parsed into BodyColorResistanceRule (lib/domain/master_data/body_color_resistance_rule.dart) — each key becomes colorId.

attributeResistanceBonuses.description: Maps an attribute id (see attributes.json) to the resistance bonus this color grants. If this color has at least one positive entry, its negative entries are automatically zeroed out when it becomes an SP color; colors with only negative (or no) entries are unaffected by SP status. A solo color with no entries here automatically grants +1 to every attribute.
